description: The judge panel: exactly one judge per model family, so no family gets two votes. Whether a judge is an interested party depends on the debate (e.g. Anthropic and OpenAI in the subagents debates; Anthropic and xAI in the Opus 5 vs Grok 4.6 debates) — rh analyze-bias derives interest from the debaters' model families. Pricing for every model id must exist in pricing.json.
